settings.shareSetup.sub: Settings, geofences and profiles as a link
syncInterval.sub.0: Each fix is its own request · radio never idles
syncInterval.sub.60: One request a minute · fixes wait in between
syncInterval.sub.300: One request every 5 min · fewer wake-ups
syncInterval.sub.900: One request every 15 min · the server hears you up to 15 min late
syncInterval.field.hint: Longer means fewer requests and a later server.
syncInterval.field.hintMin: At least {{min}} s. Longer means fewer requests and a later server.
trackingSync.intro: How often a fix is recorded and when it syncs. Changes apply at once and restart tracking.
trackingSync.custom.sub: Your own interval and movement threshold
trackingSync.interval.hint: At least 1 s. Shorter keeps the GPS awake more of the time and records more points.
trackingSync.distance.hint: Skips a fix closer than this to the last one. 0 keeps every fix. Saves storage, not battery.
trackingSync.batch.hint: {{min}} to {{max}} points per request. Larger means fewer requests and bigger payloads.
trackingSync.condition.any.sub: Mobile data and Wi-Fi · syncs never wait, counts against your data plan
trackingSync.condition.wifiAny.sub: Unmetered networks only · fixes wait on mobile data
trackingSync.condition.wifiSsid.sub: One network by name · fixes wait elsewhere
trackingSync.condition.vpn.sub: Only while a VPN is up · fixes wait otherwise
trackingSync.ssid.empty: Nothing syncs until a network is named
trackingSync.filter.on: Drops fixes the chip rates worse than {{threshold}}. Stricter leaves gaps indoors.
trackingSync.filter.off: Every fix is kept. When on, fixes worse than {{threshold}} are dropped.
trackingSync.threshold.hint: At least 1 {{unit}}. The chip's own estimate, often optimistic; lower drops more fixes.

profiles.intro: Checked top to bottom while tracking runs. The first profile whose condition holds replaces the Tracking & sync values.
profiles.empty.title: No profiles yet

profileEditor.delete.title: Delete profile

profileEditor.name: Name

profileEditor.priority.hint: Higher wins when two profiles match at once. Equal numbers go to the older profile.
profileEditor.interval.hint: At least 1 s. Replaces the {{duration}} from Tracking & sync while this profile is active. Shorter keeps the GPS awake more of the time and records more points.
profileEditor.stationaryLong: Longer than {{max}} s may leave the first {{duration}} of a trip unrecorded
profileEditor.distance.stationary: Not used while still · a point is recorded every interval
profileEditor.distance.hint: At least 0 {{unit}}. Replaces the {{distance}} from Tracking & sync. 0 records any movement, larger skips small drift.
profileEditor.sync.hint: Replaces the {{interval}} from Tracking & sync while this profile is active · shorter means more wake-ups
profileEditor.activation.hintStationary: How long every fix must read as still; 0 switches at the first still fix. Moving again ends the profile at once.
profileEditor.activation.hint: How long the condition must hold first. 0 switches at once, longer ignores a brief plug or unplug.
profileEditor.deactivation.hint: How long the profile stays on after its condition ends. Longer rides out a brief gap.

disclosure.location.title: Location data collection
disclosure.location.p1: Colota collects location data to enable GPS tracking and sending your position to your configured server, even when the app is closed or not in use.
disclosure.location.p2: This data is sent only to the server you set up. No data is shared with third parties.
disclosure.location.p3: While tracking runs, a persistent notification shows its status. Battery optimization should be disabled for reliable background operation.
disclosure.network.title: Local network access
disclosure.network.p1: Your server is on the local network. Colota needs local network access permission to reach it.
disclosure.network.p2: This permission is only used to connect to your self-hosted server. No device scanning or discovery is performed.
